tool_args.rationale: Both the Hill-2 inhibition/linear-bleed fit and the negative-square-root siphon fit missed fresh confirmation by a wide margin. The remaining measurements confound input and sink gradient, so another informative batch is warranted before choosing a different quantitative law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The current input and gradient co-vary, so these rows do not cleanly identify its separate effects; the attempted siphon fits also failed fresh confirmation.
Fresh confirmation refuted two candidate mechanisms, but it has not ruled out all stationary smooth mechanisms or shown chaotic oscillations.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
